answer: We enforce game-theoretic Sybil resistance among autonomous agents by requiring each identity to lock collateral in a decentralized vault and execute a cryptographic kernel. In the walnut consensus model, any adversarial agent attempting to partition the network faces an expected utility of U < 0 due to quadratic slashing of locked assets, guaranteeing a Byzantine Fault Tolerant Nash equilibrium where honest execution remains the unique subgame perfect strategy.
